decision.title: XQuery conformance sweep 2 (packet )
decision.summary: XQuery parameter defaults become default functions called with the caller's focus, XQuery closures read globals at call time, units keep IR modules, and fn:load-xquery-module honours trusted.

body.p: , after , , . Closes (b) to (g) and 's "Not done" but where said. No public header changed; no IR kind.

item.p: Default functions (glossary , (b), (g)): a declared function's optional parameter whose default is not := . is SXML_PARAMETER_DEFAULT_EXPRESSION with a default_function_number (sxml_function_parameter): an IR function of three parameters, the caller's context value, position and size, whose body is the default coerced to the parameter's type, lowered with those slots as its focus; its IR function's names the parts it reads (the lowering focus records parts_read). Static calls go to the full arity and call the default functions of the omitted parameters with their own focus (sxml_xpath_lowerer_call_default_function), so keyword arguments after omitted parameters work (modules-40) and $x := string() sees the caller's context value (5.18.3). A reference F#N whose omitted defaults read the focus is a closure that captures those parts and calls the defaults when called (so $x := (., local:f#0) ends); a reference made without a focus is the shorter arity's IR function, which calls the defaults with its absent focus. Defaults are lowered first in every module; one that calls a default not lowered yet passes all parts without reading them, and a fixpoint over the default functions' calls adds the parts they pass on.

Closures of XQuery globals ( (c)): find_free_variables captures no global in XQuery (the unit's global table is read at call time, ); the dependency walk ignores a variable's edge to itself (a read while it is computed is BEING_COMPUTED, XQDY0054). XPath and XSLT still capture (function items outlive their evaluation there).

fn:function-lookup ( (d)): sxml_evaluator_find_unit_function finds a top-level named IR function of the calling task's unit (XQuery declared functions, XSLT stylesheet functions) before the host's table.

"##any" ( (e)): has_any_default_element_namespace in the XPath static context; prefix 0 is bound to no namespace (constructed elements); an unprefixed name test or element test is *:local, an unprefixed type name is in xs (sxml_xpath_resolved_name's is_any_namespace).
QT4 driver ( (f)): assert-eq atomizes a single node.

IR modules (glossary ; 's Proposed): a unit keeps one (source name, static base URI) per library module (sxml_ir_unit_add_module); every IR function a library module's lowering makes carries its module_number; the evaluator's static base URI and error locations read the function's module.

Trust (F&O 4.0, 18.2): trusted (default false) marks the loaded unit untrusted (sxml_ir_unit_set_untrusted), as is every unit an untrusted call loads; fn:doc, unparsed-text(-lines), unparsed-binary, collection and uri-collection raise FODC0016 when the running unit is untrusted (sxml_dynamic_context_check_trust).
A library module's context value type (): without a main module declaration, the first library module's type is the context global's (fn:load-xquery-module checks it, FOQM0005).

Function annotations: IR functions carry their %annotations, copied into the unit (sxml_ir_unit_add_function_annotations, sxml_xpath_lowerer_read_annotations) for inline and declared functions; partial applications keep them (static and fn:partial-apply).
Also: keyword placeholders take their written order (FunctionCall-416); an xs:untypedAtomic array lookup key is cast to xs:integer (4.7.3).

Not done: hintless imports of a namespace split over modules (needs a resolver contract in include/sxml/xquery.h, kept as says); a fixed default's one value for every call (function-decl-40-060); the focus of fn:function-lookup (XP and XQ, 47 cases); static-base-uri#0 made in a library module and called elsewhere (xqhof16, 18); "fixed" default element namespaces; both main and library context value types at once (contextDecl-050, -051).

Measured (release, all 737 sets of each spec; before at 01cf728, after at 5611dd2): XQ40 39,928 to 40,025 passed, in scope 96.9 % to 97.2 %, XQ-only 9,325 to 9,404 of 9,523 (97.9 % to 98.8 %), failed 518 to 422, "error" outcomes 1 to 0 (the Phase 3 gate's last open count); none lost; prod-FunctionDecl 211 to 227, fn-function-annotations 14 to 23, fn-load-xquery-module 103 to 111, prod-DefaultNamespaceDecl 71 to 78, app-Demos 4 to 11; method-* 97.5 %. XP40 30,630 to 30,646, in scope 97.0 % to 97.1 %, 0 errors, none lost. Slice 198/198.
